name: Clicking Do Not Enroll on the Decline warning shows the Thank You acknowledgment popup
EULA banner appears on login for a user who has not yet confirmed the EULA
Logging in with a disenrolled account shows the 'Account is deactivated' error
Clicking Back on the Thank You popup returns the user to the original EULA modal
Clicking Decline on the EULA shows the mandatory-acceptance warning with Do Not Enroll and Go Back
Declining the EULA does not set the Confirmed On date, and the banner reappears on reload
EULA modal displays a language switcher and Accept/Decline buttons
EULA modal's language switcher defaults to English (EN)
Clicking Accept dismisses the EULA modal
Clicking Go Back on the Decline warning returns the user to the original EULA modal
